description: Developed KwaraTech Academy website, implementing the backend using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB to securely store student data. Integrated Nodemailer to facilitate automated email communication, sending user data to the admin and a thank-you email to registered users.

Designed and implemented a registration and login system, utilizing MongoDB to securely store user data, including email addresses and hashed passwords. This solution is designed to address accommodation-related challenges.
Developed and optimized the landing page, admissions page, and blog page for Bttrschools website using WordPress, resulting in a 40% increase in user engagement.
